name: Payment of Tuition Fees and Examination Fees to OBC Girls Pursuing Professional Courses (व्यावसायिक अभ्यासक्रमास प्रवेश घेणाऱ्या इतर मागास प्रवर्गातील मुलींना शिक्षण शुल्क व परीक्षा शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ती)
department: Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: Provides 100% reimbursement of tuition and examination fees to eligible female OBC/EWS/SEBC students admitted through CAP in recognized professional courses with family annual income up to Rs. 8 Lakh under GR 8 July 2024. Crucially, provides NO maintenance allowance. (DRAFT CANDIDATE - NON-PRODUCTION)
benefits: 100% Tuition Fee waiver / reimbursement approved by Fee Regulating Authority (FRA)
NO monthly maintenance allowance is provided under this scheme
required_documents: Caste Certificate (OBC) issued by Sub-Divisional Officer / Deputy Collector
Valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate for current financial year
Income Certificate (<= Rs. 8,00,000) issued by Tahsildar
CAP Allotment Letter confirming admission via Centralized Admission Process
College fee receipt and Bonafide Certificate
Previous qualifying examination marksheet (minimum 75% attendance record)

sources.evidence_excerpt: शासन निर्णय क्र. शिष्यवृ-२०२४/प्र.क्र.१०५/तांशि-४ दिनांक ०८ जुलै २०२४: उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभाग अंतर्गत व्यावसायिक अभ्यासक्रमांना केंद्रीभूत प्रवेश प्रक्रियेद्वारे (CAP) प्रवेश घेतलेल्या इतर मागास वर्ग (OBC), ईडब्ल्यूएस व एसईबीसी प्रवर्गातील मुलींना, ज्यांच्या कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न रु. ८.०० लाखांपर्यंत आहे, त्यांना १००% शिक्षण शुल्क व परीक्षा शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ती. (कोणताही निर्वाह भत्ता अनुज्ञेय नाही).

sources.source_name: MahaDBT 2.0 Fee Waiver Scheme Portal Guidelines
sources.evidence_excerpt: MahaDBT 2.0 Notification - Payment of Tuition Fees and Examination Fees to OBC Girls Pursuing Professional Courses: Female OBC students admitted through CAP round in approved professional/technical courses. Family annual income up to Rs. 8,00,000 with valid Non-Creamy Layer. 75% minimum attendance required. 100% fee waiver only.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: महाराष्ट्र राज्यातील उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभागाच्या मान्यताप्राप्त व्यावसायिक अभ्यासक्रमास प्रवेश घेतलेली विद्यार्थिनी.
evidence.translated_excerpt: Female student admitted to recognized professional courses under Higher & Technical Education Dept in Maharashtra.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: इतर मागास प्रवर्ग (OBC), ईडब्ल्यूएस व एसईबीसी प्रवर्गातील विद्यार्थिनी.
evidence.translated_excerpt: Girl students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBC), EWS, and SEBC categories.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: इतर मागास प्रवर्ग (OBC), ईडब्ल्यूएस व एसईबीसी प्रवर्गातील मुलींना ५०% ऐवजी १००% शिक्षण शुल्क व परीक्षा शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ती.
evidence.translated_excerpt: Reimbursement of 100% instead of 50% tuition and examination fees to girls belonging to OBC, EWS and SEBC categories.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: विद्यार्थिनीने चालू शैक्षणिक वर्षात मान्यताप्राप्त अभ्यासक्रमात नियमित प्रवेश घेतलेला असावा.
evidence.translated_excerpt: The female student must have secured regular admission in an approved course during current academic year.
evidence.notes: Applies exclusively to students admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) in approved professional courses.

evidence.verbatim_excerpt: ज्यांच्या कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न रु. ८,००,०००/- पर्यंत आहे अशा मुलींना.
evidence.translated_excerpt: For girl students whose family annual income is up to Rs. 8,00,000/-.
evidence.notes: Crucially, this scheme provides 100% tuition and examination fee waiver only. No maintenance allowance.
